purpose: Development-time reference inventory and source navigation for ProjectBeta. Not an app content schema or release dataset.

page_conventions.pdf_pages: One-based file page positions, including covers and blanks.
page_conventions.printed_pages: Visible book numbering, or expected sequence at documented blank/numbering exceptions. Ranges are inclusive.
page_conventions.body_offsets: Offsets apply only to the main numbered body. Separate booklet/appendix locations explicitly provide their own PDF and printed ranges.
page_conventions.level_labels: N5/N4 are the owner-provided filename labels. Textbook volumes and the 2nd edition were checked from covers/title pages. Individual JLPT item levels have not been classified.
page_conventions.kanji_relationships: N5 uses grouped reference scopes and publisher milestones. N4 units 21–25 are preparatory review/supplement through Elementary I lesson 25; units 26–50 map to same-numbered Elementary II lessons. Scope does not imply every word belongs exclusively to that lesson.
page_conventions.product_boundary: Publisher milestones do not decide application learned-prefix state, widget eligibility across levels, or final independently authored item counts.
